title: Uniden Strengthens Industry Leadership with Appointment of Industry Veteran J.J. Langguth | User | mammothtimes.com
text:
Uniden America proudly announces the strategic appointment of automotive industry expert J.J. Langguth as National Sales and Dealership Manager, underscoring Uniden’s unwavering commitment to innovation, growth, and leadership excellence.
Langguth’s career is marked by consistently driving growth and profitability, pioneering strategic collaborations, and implementing groundbreaking solutions within the 12v Retailer and Car Dealership sector.
Renowned for his expertise forging influential car dealership alliances, Langguth’s unique skillset is precisely aligned with Uniden’s growth strategy. His adeptness at establishing long-lasting relationships will significantly bolster Uniden’s expansion into New Car Dealership Growth and the rapidly evolving the Expeditor market.
"We’re thrilled to welcome J.J. Langguth to the Uniden family as our new National Sales and Dealership Manager," said Ray Woolf, Director of Specialty Radar Sales for Uniden America. "J.J. represents a significant milestone and truly excites our entire team. His unparalleled industry insight and proven revenue-driving leadership will be instrumental as we strengthen our dealership and expeditor segments. On a personal note, I'm delighted to come full circle and collaborate with J.J. again to achieve new heights in our business."
"After nearly three incredible decades with K40 Electronics, I'm energized to bring my extensive experience and passion to Uniden. Joining the Uniden team is a tremendous opportunity, and I look forward to collaborating closely with a dynamic group of dedicated professionals to drive continued success," J.J. expressed.
Langguth’s leadership and strategic vision will enhance Uniden's position as an industry frontrunner in automotive radar and laser detection technology, further reinforcing the company's commitment to excellence and customer satisfaction.
About Uniden America: Uniden America Corporation, headquartered in Flower Mound, Texas, specializes in state-of-the-art radar detectors, laser protection systems, and automotive electronics, committed to innovation, quality, and performance.
